events.text: Ferdinand Magellan sets sail from Spain on the first voyage around the world.
Battle of Valmy: French revolutionary troops halt the Prussian invasion.
The first Cannes Film Festival opens.
The ocean liner Queen Elizabeth 2 is launched in Scotland.
Billie Jean King beats Bobby Riggs in the "Battle of the Sexes" tennis match.
President George W. Bush declares a "war on terror" in an address to Congress.
